issues.reason: BeforeByAtLeast is not in the relational vocabulary — Before and BeforeBy are the only ordering heads, and "Never coin a relation head" bars minting an at-least variant.
"Emit each measure in its stated unit (unchanged)" — decade to 10 year is a translator-side conversion the seeded lexicon is supposed to perform, and the same section says never compute it yourself.

gaps_confirmed: a lower-bounded temporal distance ("more than a decade ago") has no licensed carrier: BeforeBy takes an exact magnitude, TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost need calendar terms plus an anchor date, and MeasureAtLeast measures the event's own extent, not a gap
new_gaps: the seeded unit lexicon gives time factors only down to day (minute 60, hour 3600, day 86400) — week, year and decade have none, so even an exactly stated multi-year gap could not chain across units
repair_summary: Replaced the coined (BeforeByAtLeast sk_story_1 now 10 year) with the licensed weaker ordering (Before sk_story_1 now) — the ordering against `now` that the atom carried is retained, while the unrepresentable "more than a decade" bound is dropped rather than encoded as a false exact gap or an invented head.
notes: The light-verb handling is untouched and correct: Past sits directly on the story witness, with no reified occur event.
